subject: Request: Extend POC window — QA build freeze blocking demo
messages:
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@brightleaf.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QA build freeze — blocked demo next week

Diego / Monica,

Quick update from our side — our QA team hit a blocker while validating the connector and they've frozen the branch to triage. The issue shows up under load when the KV cache warms (attached error snippets). Our engineering lead estimates 6-8 business days to complete the fix + regression testing. That pushes our scheduled demo on 9/24 out of the window.

We're still excited to proceed but need a bit more time on the POC sandbox. Is there any way Redwood can extend our trial environment or grant a short promo/top-up so we don't lose momentum? We also have stakeholders ready to attend the demo as soon as we can rebook.

Attached: error-log-20260917.txt, short screenshots, and updated demo-plan-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Evan Cho
Senior Platform Engineer
BrightLeaf

--

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@brightleaf.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QA build freeze — blocked demo next week

Thanks for the heads-up, Evan — I appreciate the detail and the logs. Sorry to hear about the freeze.

Short answer: yes, we can help. I'll need to loop in Monica (sales ops) for any formal extension/top-up and Rishi for potential quota/billing adjustments if needed. Can you confirm two things for me so I can accelerate this: (1) approximate new target demo window after the fix (earliest dates), and (2) whether you need just a time extension on the sandbox or additional capacity (more tokens/instances) while you run load repros?

If you can give me those, I'll propose an internal approval path. If it's just a time extension, Monica usually approves a one-time 14-day POC extension for engineering delays; anything beyond that we route to the deal team.

Also copying a proposed mitigation: we can temporarily route your POC traffic to a dedicated lower-latency pool to reduce stress on the test branch while you repro. That would be a config change on our side and shouldn't take >24 hours to flip.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: demo-plan-v2.pdf

--

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@brightleaf.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QA build freeze — blocked demo next week

Diego / Evan — quick follow-up after reviewing the notes and logs. Approved: one-time 21-day POC extension and a temporary sandbox capacity bump (2 additional instances, no charge) to help with repro runs.

Operational notes (for the record):
- Extension window: 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-15 (21 days)
- Capacity bump active immediately and will be monitored; auto-revoke on 2026-10-15 unless you request an extension in writing before that date.
- No changes to existing pricing or deal terms; this is a one-off courtesy tied to DL-4821-BL to keep momentum.
- Evan, please reply with the earliest new demo dates and confirm you received the sandbox capacity bump. I'll log this in HubSpot and attach the updated demo plan.

Diego, Rishi: tagging you both to ensure billing and instrumentation reflect the temporary change. Rishi, please confirm the capacity has been provisioned and that audit logs will show the trial extension.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4821
Attachments applied: demo-plan-v2.pdf

--
